statement: The function returns a result r, and r = sum_{v in D, v > min(nums)} C(v), where D = {v | there exists i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v}, min(nums) is the least value occurring in nums, and for each v, C(v) = #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] >= v}. This sum is exactly the number of operations performed by the deterministic process in the problem statement before all elements become equal.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000.

statement: The function returns successfully with some result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow on any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= len(nums) * (d - 1), where d is the number of distinct values occurring in nums, i.e. d = #{v | there exists i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v}.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[0].

statement: The function returns a result r and r = #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = b}, where b is the larger element of D.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000, and there exist integers a and b with a < b such that D = {a, b}, where D = {v | there exists i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v}.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if all elements of nums are equal, i.e. for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[0].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = len(nums) * (len(nums) - 1) / 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000, and for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} L(nums[i]), where for each integer x, L(x) = #{v | v occurs in nums and v < x}.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000.

statement: Whenever reduction_operations nums returns a result r and reduction_operations nums2 returns a result r2, r = r2.
preconditions: nums and nums2 are slices of i64 such that both satisfy 1 <= len <= 50000 and 1 <= element <= 50000, and for every integer v, #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v} = #{j | 0 <= j < len(nums2) and nums2[j] = v}.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= N, where N = #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] > min(nums)} and min(nums) is the least value occurring in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 50000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000.

statement: If reduction_operations nums returns a result r and reduction_operations nums2 returns a result r2, then r2 = r + d, where d = #{v | there exists i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v}.
preconditions: nums is a slice of i64 with 1 <= len(nums) <= 49999 and 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000 for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums); M is an integer with 1 <= M <= 50000 and M > nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums); nums2 is the slice of length len(nums)+1 such that nums2[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums2[len(nums)] = M.

statement: If reduction_operations nums returns a result r and reduction_operations nums2 returns a result r2, then r2 = r + #{v | v occurs in nums and v < x}.
preconditions: nums is a slice of i64 with 1 <= len(nums) <= 49999 and 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000 for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums); x is an integer with 1 <= x <= 50000 that occurs in nums; nums2 is the slice of length len(nums)+1 such that nums2[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums2[len(nums)] = x.

statement: If reduction_operations nums returns a result r and reduction_operations nums2 returns a result r2, then r2 = r + len(nums).
preconditions: nums is a slice of i64 with 1 <= len(nums) <= 49999 and 1 <= nums[i] <= 50000 for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums); M is an integer with 1 <= M <= 50000 and M < nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums); nums2 is the slice of length len(nums)+1 such that nums2[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums2[len(nums)] = M.
